spec.name: lakefs
allowedSchemaBucketsForLinking
spec.description: Whitelist of cloud storage scheme+bucket prefixes (e.g. s3://my-bucket, gs://my-bucket) that are allowed as link sources when the source bucket differs from the repository's backing bucket. Only used with `physical_path` transfer mode.

spec.name: autoCreateBranch
spec.description: Automatically create the branch if it does not exist when writing to it (default: false)

spec.name: autoCreateBranchSource
spec.description: Source branch to use when auto-creating a new branch (default: main)

spec.name: transferMode
spec.description: Transfer mode: `signed_url` (default) or `physical_path`. Use `physical_path` for zero-copy linking and direct cloud-provider transfers (requires the matching nf-amazon or nf-google plugin).

spec.name: readTimeout
spec.description: HTTP read timeout for lakeFS API calls (default: 60s)

spec.name: connectTimeout
spec.description: HTTP connect timeout for lakeFS API calls (default: 30s)

spec.name: autoCommit
spec.description: When enabled, automatically commit the branch backing the workflow output directory (`outputDir`/`-output-dir`) once the workflow completes successfully, using `params.lakefs_commit_message` as the commit message (default: `false`)
The `lakefs` scope allows you to configure the `nf-lakefs` plugin.
